main_text.p: ipso cadauere remanet ociosus: Nam nullo munere cadaueris partes fungi tā certum est, quàm quod certissimum. Ad cœlos autem ipsum redire, ne probabile quidem uidetur. Cùm enim sit accides, ideo loco moueri sine aliquo subiecto nequit. At uerò singula animalia interire, nemo sanè est, qui non satis uideat. Quare animalium nullum coelestem esse calorem ac diuinum omnibus satis patere putamus.
main_text.head: EXERC. XIX.
DE MORBIS TOTIVS SVBSTANTIAE, seu formæ partis similaris.
main_text.p: POsthęc ad totius substantiæ morbum, quem Fernelius libro de Differentiis morborum, formæ corruptelam nominat, progredi licet. Cæterùm in primis rationes, quibus hoc nomen morbi genus probare studet, examinare expedit: Quarum prima est, omnes nostri corporis partes sic agere, ut struthiocameli uenter, qui non elementorum calore, non insito temperamento, sed totius essentiæ natura fer-rum exterit & concoquit. Verùm in primis hoc consequetur absurdū, nempe partium

page.notes: The first letter "P" of "POsthęc" is a large drop initial, joined to the word as printed. Quotation-like marks („) stand in the right margin beside the lines from "Quarum" to "partium". They are marks, not text, so they are not transcribed as notes. Doubtful readings: "coelos" and "coelestem" (ligature of æ/oe not clear); "absurdū" (macron read from the scan); "Verùm" (accent as printed). The running head is printed in small capitals and the u of "CAVSAS" was changed to u as the rules require.
